scope: Outdoor stylized parking structures. Campus GIS footprints are retained. Visible deck counts, dimensions, facade rhythm and ramp positions are authored approximations informed by public Facilities photographs, not surveyed construction models. No floor plans or access-controlled material used.

confirmedGarages.name: Union Lane Parking Garage
confirmedGarages.features: Open decks, exposed concrete structure and red brick parapets; the official approach description places the Fieldhouse Drive entry downhill from STAMP.

confirmedGarages.name: Regents Drive Parking Garage
confirmedGarages.features: Brick/concrete open parking bays, glazed stair enclosure; the model preserves the surveyed irregular perimeter but does not reproduce the circular ramp tower in detail.

confirmedGarages.name: Stadium Drive Parking Garage
confirmedGarages.features: Distinctive crescent-shaped footprint from official Facilities rooflines; slab and parapet geometry follow this shape rather than an enclosing rectangle.

confirmedGarages.name: Terrapin Trail Parking Garage
confirmedGarages.features: Long open parking decks near XFINITY and the Wooded Hillock; exact facade details are approximate.

confirmedGarages.name: Mowatt Lane Parking Garage
confirmedGarages.features: Repeated open bays, brick piers and horizontal concrete floor edges; modeled as six parking levels including the rooftop, with authored floor-to-floor height.

sources.supports: Campus Drive climbs uphill to STAMP; Union Lane Garage vehicle entrance is on Fieldhouse Drive, followed by an uphill walk to STAMP.
